'''Jorin din Jubai White Wing''' is [[Windfinder]] on the ''[[Wavedancer]]'' and serves with her sister [[Coine din Jubai Wild Winds]].{{ref/book|4|19}} As a Windfinder, Jorin is a [[channeler]].

== Appearance ==
She looks similar to her sister but is much younger. Her coloring is dark, as is common among ''[[Atha'an Miere]]''.  She wears tattoos on her hands of stars and seabirds surrounded by the curls and whirls of stylized waves. {{ref/book|4|19}}

== Activities ==
She is on the same [[raker]] as [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] when they go from [[Tear]] to [[Tanchico]] when they are tracking down the [[Black Ajah]].

Jorin impresses Elayne with her cable-thick [[weave]]s of Air and Water and agrees to teach her the techniques of a [[Windfinder]].{{ref/book|4|20}}
